projects.title: Citizen Housing
projects.description: Whilst at Mediaworks I worked within a small team to help deliver front-end and back-end development using Umbraco (.NET) and Tailwind for Citizen Housing, attracting thousands of monthly visitors and exceeding client expectations. This project also required a high focus on accessiblity which we were able to deliver.

projects.title: West Yorkshire Combined Authority
projects.description: This was another large enterprise project (At Mediaworks) using Umbraco (.NET), Tailwind where I was able to work with multiple other developers under short time contraints and create a product the client was happy with.

projects.title: Home Energy West Yorkshire
projects.description: Second of the two large sites for West Yorkshire that I helped get over the line. Being able to work closely with other developers and create a site which allowed users to check the energy effiency of their home.
